measurement: Exact Euclidean point-to-retained-convex-union distances on original omitted vertices and every triangulated convex facet centroid at the stated finite poses. Separately proven conservative all-point/continuous-pose bounds use one retained convex shape with the same owner.
limits: Finite union samples are not a global Hausdorff distance, uniform material thickness or an actor-fit guarantee.
Fine mechanism, pin and cable details stay visually present and are omitted from optional BODY collision only. Open service states expose those fine details.
Precise tools/interaction targeting and detailed mechanism checks must use unchanged detailed source/markers/profiles.
No engine adoption, dynamic load support, actual contact response, six-species fit, host routes or performance acceptance.
